ModMetaData.name: Ecotech (Local)
ModMetaData.author: Sepphoris,NightmareCorporation
ModMetaData.description:
Mod Version: 1.1.0 (last updated @ 7.18.2025, ~2:00PM PST)
====================
A high fantasy, tribal-oriented mod that introduces the ability to grow weapons and defenses in your garden, rather than machining them together.
Currently introduces several terraweapons, new materials, and new structures, all of which only require a green thumb to plant, and patience to grow. They are just as effective as fabricated weapons, giving you a 100% all-natural, viable alternative to your colony defenses.
No more need to be forced into higher tech levels to defend yourself! The goal of this mod is to provide a tribal-friendly way of upscaling your colony, while also being balanced.
====================
Latest Major Features and Changes:
-Overhauled how research is done -Addition of Briar gear -Addition of Periwood gear -Addition of Terratech Curators -Addition of many new and WIP saps and weapons
Latest Minor Update: -Many balancing tweaks regarding numbers, and tweaking research numbers
====================
-Please report balancing and bug issues on the workshop page!
